answer: Physical Coupon Voyage Binding. Each identity must redeem a single-use code printed on a physical coupon, mailed to a verified street address; codes expire after one voyage through the postal system. The issuing inlet logs each address once, so duplicates are rejected at redemption. A vine of linked addresses exposes the constraint: an attacker needs one real mailbox per identity, paying rent, postage, and handling time for each, making mass fabrication physically costly.
